messages.title: Your Tuesday shift lands on top of BIO class and lab
messages.body:
You said you work Tue 6–11 PM. BIO 110 meets Tue 6:00–7:30 PM and the Tuesday-only lab runs 7:45–9:45 PM. Scholz docks 25 points for the first missed lab, so this one is expensive.

Which is it: did the shift change, is BIO meeting at a different time than I have on file, or are you planning to miss the lab? Tell me and I'll rebuild Tuesday around the real answer. That Tuesday has now passed — let me know how it actually went so future Tuesdays don't repeat the same guesswork.

messages.title: Everything now lands here instead of the chat
messages.body:
This Brief tab is the new home for your morning digest and anything I need to tell you — check here, not the chat. The badge on the tab shows unread messages.

Your study guides are also synced to Google Drive, in a folder called "School — Study Guides". Every guide, flashcard deck and practice set is there, and it re-syncs on its own each day, so it opens on your phone, laptop, or anything you sign into. The three files starting with READABLE are cleaned-up Google Docs, easiest to read on a phone.

One limit worth knowing: this app is a static page, so messages only go one direction. When something is tagged QUESTION it needs an actual answer from you in a chat — everything else is just me keeping you posted.

messages.title: BIO Unit 1 Exam format confirmed — take-home posts Tue 9/8
messages.body:
Dr. Scholz posted the full format. The exam is 100 points in two parts. Take-home (50 pts): PDF drops in the Week 3 module on Tuesday Sep 8 -- the day after you get back. You may work with other people and use any resource except her, including AI, as long as you cite it. In-person (50 pts): on paper Thursday Sep 17, starts 6 PM, no end time, and nothing but your brain, scrap paper and a calculator.

Two notes: the syllabus said 45+45=90 for each unit exam and this says 50+50=100 -- going with her Canvas number. And Tuesday Sep 15's class is a Q&A/review session for this exam, so bring questions. Your bio110-unit1 study pack already covers Ch 1-3 and the first three labs.
